answer: A payout is split and therefore 31% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The fable schedule is applied in crystal and violet shows each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3350 identities would post 877 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
